    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with("[ban] kicked 10.77.") && l.ends_with("\"Ann\": \"Stop ramming\"")), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with("[ban] #1 \"Ann\" for 3 d (until ")), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(
        lines.iter().any(|l| l == "[ban] a client at an address of ban #1 \"Ann\" plays on, out of races (its address only)"),
        "{lines:?}"
    );
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l == "[ban] turned away a client of ban #1 \"Ann\" (its page or keyphrase)"), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with("[ban] lifted #1 \"Ann\"; races again: ") && l.ends_with(" \"Neil\"")), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.ends_with(&format!("{phone_vip} \"Ann\"; out of races now: {neil_vip} \"Neil\""))), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with("[ban] #2 \"Racer\" (c1) for 1 d (until ")), "{lines:?}");
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains("192.0.2")), "no client address in the log: {lines:?}");
}

// A race ban keeps its player on the switch, out of races: its page hears why at once and at each hello, and that it
// races again when the ban is lifted; `change` makes it a full ban and back.  A rename takes the name away from
// everyone: the player's page is asked for another, a hello under it (or under one that reads the same) is too, one
// under another name plays on.  `history` says what each player had, and a new ban's reply what it had before
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn race_bans_renames_and_history_through_the_control_socket() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let (port, state) = (free_port(), tmp.path().join("state"));
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--online", "off", "--roam-hub", "off"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let hello = |name: &str, id: &str| serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": name, "id": id }).to_string();
    let open = |xff: &'static str, name: &'static str, id: &'static str| {
        let (host, hello) = (host.clone(), hello(name, id));
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_from(&host, port, "", None, None, Some(xff)).await;
            b.text(&hello);
            b
        }
    };
    let cat = open("192.0.2.1", "Cat", "page-cat").await;
    let dan = open("192.0.2.2", "B4dName", "page-dan").await;
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    while !ctl(&state, &["who"]).1.contains("\"B4dName\"") && t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3) {
        sleep(50).await;
    }
    let races = |g: &Got| g.ctl.iter().rev().find(|m| m["t"] == "races").cloned();

    // a race ban: Cat stays, out of races, and hears why; again in another tab
    let cat_vip = nfsu2_util::vip_str(cat.vip);
    let rb = ctl(&state, &["raceban", "cat", "2w", "Cheating", "in", "races"]);
    assert_eq!(rb.0, 0, "{}", rb.1);
    assert!(rb.1.starts_with("race ban #1: \"Cat\" for 14 d (until "), "{}", rb.1);
    assert!(rb.1.ends_with(&format!("by its page and its address\nout of races now: {cat_vip} \"Cat\"")), "{}", rb.1);
    assert_eq!(cat.until_ms(3000, races).await["msg"], "Cheating in races");
    let tab = open("192.0.2.1", "Cat", "page-cat").await;
    assert_eq!(tab.until_ms(3000, races).await["msg"], "Cheating in races");
    sleep(200).await;
    assert!(cat.is_open() && tab.is_open(), "a race ban removes nobody");
    assert!(ctl(&state, &["bans"]).1.contains("race ban until "), "{}", ctl(&state, &["bans"]).1);
    // made a full ban: removed; a race ban for a week again
    let ch = ctl(&state, &["change", "#1", "full"]);
    assert!(ch.1.starts_with("#1 \"Cat\": ban for 14 d (until "), "{}", ch.1);
    assert_eq!(cat.until_ms(3000, |g| g.closed.clone()).await, (4003, "banned".into()));
    let ch = ctl(&state, &["change", "#1", "1w", "races"]);
    assert!(ch.1.starts_with("#1 \"Cat\": race ban for 7 d (until "), "{}", ch.1);
    // lifted: the one on the switch races again
    let cat = open("192.0.2.1", "Cat", "page-cat").await;
    assert!(cat.until_ms(3000, races).await["until"].is_i64());
    let cat_vip = nfsu2_util::vip_str(cat.vip);
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["unban", "#1"]), (0, format!("lifted #1 \"Cat\" (race ban); races again: {cat_vip} \"Cat\"")));
    assert_eq!(cat.until_ms(3000, |g| races(g).filter(|m| m["lifted"] == true)).await["lifted"], true);

    // a rename: Dan's page is asked for another name
    let rn = ctl(&state, &["rename", "b4dname", "Offensive", "name"]);
    assert_eq!(rn.0, 0, "{}", rn.1);
    assert!(rn.1.starts_with("rename #2: \"B4dName\" taken away from everyone, and the names that read the same"), "{}", rn.1);
    assert_eq!(dan.until_ms(3000, |g| g.closed.clone()).await, (4004, "rename".into()));
    let told = dan.got().ctl.iter().find(|m| m["t"] == "rename").cloned().expect("the rename's message");
    assert_eq!((told["name"].clone(), told["msg"].clone()), (Value::from("B4dName"), Value::from("Offensive name")));
    // a hello under a name that reads the same: asked too; under another, Dan plays on
    let (got, closed) =
        turned_away_hello(&host, port, "192.0.2.3", serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": "BadName", "id": "page-eve" })).await;
    assert_eq!((kinds(&got).last().cloned(), closed), (Some("rename".to_string()), Some((4004, "rename".to_string()))));
    assert_eq!(got.last().map(|m| m["msg"].clone()), Some(Value::from("Offensive name")));
    let dan = open("192.0.2.2", "Dan", "page-dan").await;
    sleep(200).await;
    assert!(dan.is_open());
    assert!(ctl(&state, &["names"]).1.starts_with("\"B4dName\""), "{}", ctl(&state, &["names"]).1);

    // the history: Dan's under its new name (by its page), Cat's by its ban's number
    let h = ctl(&state, &["history", "dan"]);
    assert!(h.1.starts_with("\"Dan\": 1 in the last year\n#2 rename \"B4dName\", on "), "{}", h.1);
    let h = ctl(&state, &["history", "#1"]);
    assert!(h.1.contains("#1 race ban \"Cat\", 7 d from ") && h.1.contains(", lifted "), "{}", h.1);
    assert!(ctl(&state, &["history", "Nobody"]).1.ends_with("no bans or renames in the last year"));
    // a new ban says what the player had before
    let rb = ctl(&state, &["raceban", "cat", "perm"]);
    assert!(rb.1.contains("\nbefore: 1 (history lists them)\n  #1 race ban \"Cat\""), "{}", rb.1);
    // the name given back
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["unname", "badname"]), (0, "gave back \"B4dName\": anyone may play under it again".into()));
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["names"]), (0, "no names taken away".into()));

    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
    let lines = srv.lines();
    for start in [
        "[ban] race ban #1 \"Cat\" for 14 d (until ",
        "[ban] a client of race ban #1 \"Cat\" plays on, out of races",
        "[ban] changed #1 \"Cat\": ban for 14 d",
        "[ban] lifted #1 \"Cat\" (race ban); races again: ",
        "[ban] rename #2 \"B4dName\": \"B4dName\": \"Offensive name\"; asked for another name: ",
        "[ban] asked a client under \"BadName\" for another name (\"B4dName\": rename #2)",
        "[ban] gave back \"B4dName\"",
    ] {
        assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with(start)), "{start}: {lines:?}");
    }
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains("192.0.2")), "no client address in the log: {lines:?}");
}

/// A RACEREP datagram (roam_core.h): the player's own report of a lobby sprint, 1st of `players`, in a car of this
/// type, rating, engine power (kW)
fn race_report(sender: u32, lobby: u32, players: u8, car_type: u8, rating: f32, kw: f32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 64];
    p[0..4].copy_from_slice(&lobby.to_le_bytes());
    p[4..8].copy_from_slice(&0x1757_408Bu32.to_le_bytes());
    p[8] = 1;
    p[9] = 1;
    p[10..12].copy_from_slice(&4104u16.to_le_bytes());
    p[12] = 1;
    p[13] = players;
    p[15] = car_type;
    for (k, v) in [rating, 600.0, 1.0, kw, 1338.0, 381.0, 107.4].iter().enumerate() {
        p[20 + 4 * k..24 + 4 * k].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    p[48..55].copy_from_slice(b"SKYLINE");
    dgram(14, sender, &p)
}

/// A stand-in for Discord's webhook: each request's head and body, answered 200 (as Discord's with `wait=true`)
async fn webhook() -> (String, Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, String)>>>) {
    let l = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}/api/webhooks/1/secret-token", l.local_addr().unwrap().port());
    let got: Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, String)>>> = Default::default();
    let g = got.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        while let Ok((mut s, _)) = l.accept().await {
            let mut buf = Vec::new();
            let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
            let (head, body) = loop {
                let n = s.read(&mut chunk).await.unwrap_or(0);
                if n == 0 {
                    break (String::new(), String::new());
                }
                buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);
                let Some(end) = buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b"\r\n\r\n") else { continue };
                let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..end]).to_string();
                let len = head
                    .lines()
                    .find_map(|l| l.to_ascii_lowercase().strip_prefix("content-length:").map(|v| v.trim().parse::<usize>().unwrap()))
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                if buf.len() >= end + 4 + len {
                    break (head, String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[end + 4..end + 4 + len]).to_string());
                }
            };
            g.lock().unwrap().push((head, body));
            let _ =
                s.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{}").await;
        }
    });
    (url, got)
}

// The server's own race ban (app/autoban.rs, the operator's numbers in NFSU2_CAR_BANS: the test's own here): a player
// who reports a lobby race with others in a car past them is race-banned for two weeks by its [cheat] line's handle,
// as `raceban c1 2w` would: its page hears why at once, it stays on the switch, and the ban is posted to the webhook
// (Discord's Components V2, the webhook's address never in the log); an honest car's player is let be
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn a_car_past_the_operators_numbers_is_race_banned_by_the_server() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let (port, state) = (free_port(), tmp.path().join("state"));
    let (url, posts) = webhook().await;
    let mut cmd = command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--online", "off"]);
    cmd.env("NFSU2_CAR_BANS", "kw=1500,rating=3000").env("NFSU2_BAN_WEBHOOK", &url);
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(cmd, port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let open = |xff: &'static str, name: &'static str, id: &'static str, roam: u32| {
        let host = host.clone();
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_from(&host, port, "", None, None, Some(xff)).await;
            b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": name, "id": id }).to_string());
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(roam, name.as_bytes())));
            b
        }
    };
    let evl = open("192.0.2.1", "Evl", "page-evl", 11).await;
    let ann = open("192.0.2.2", "Ann", "page-ann", 12).await;
    sleep(300).await;
    let races = |g: &Got| g.ctl.iter().rev().find(|m| m["t"] == "races").cloned();

    ann.binary(to_hub(&race_report(12, 0xA1, 4, 27, 735.0, 505.0)));
    evl.binary(to_hub(&race_report(11, 0xA1, 4, 27, 1451.0, 2829.0)));
    assert_eq!(evl.until_ms(5000, races).await["msg"], "Cheating in multiplayer races");
    assert!(wait_for(5000, || !posts.lock().unwrap().is_empty()).await, "posted");
    sleep(300).await;
    assert!(evl.is_open() && ann.is_open(), "a race ban removes nobody");
    assert!(races(&ann.got()).is_none(), "the honest car's player is let be");
    let b = ctl(&state, &["bans"]).1;
    assert!(b.starts_with("#1 ") && b.contains("\"Evl\"") && b.contains("race ban until "), "{b}");
    assert_eq!(b.lines().count(), 1, "one ban: {b}");

    let posted = posts.lock().unwrap().clone();
    assert_eq!(posted.len(), 1, "{posted:?}");
    let (head, body) = &posted[0];
    assert!(head.starts_with("POST /api/webhooks/1/secret-token?wait=true&with_components=true HTTP/1.1"), "{head}");
    assert!(head.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("content-type: application/json"), "{head}");
    let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(body).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(v["flags"], 32768);
    let parts = v["components"][0]["components"].as_array().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        parts[0]["content"],
        "### Race ban #1 · Evl\nRaced a car no tuning makes: **SKYLINE**, **2829 kW**, rated 1451, 1338 kg, 381 km/h"
    );
    let foot = parts[2]["content"].as_str().unwrap();
    assert!(
        foot.starts_with("-# Automatic · lobby sprint, 1st of 4 · 2 weeks, until <t:") && foot.ends_with(":D> · c1 · out of races now"),
        "{foot}"
    );

    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
    let lines = srv.lines();
    let has = |start: &str| lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with(start));
    assert!(
        has("[ban] race bans by the server, for 2w: a car of 1500 kW or more or a rating of 3000 or more; posted to Discord"),
        "{lines:?}"
    );
    assert!(
        lines
            .iter()
            .any(|l| l.starts_with("[cheat] ") && l.contains("\"Evl\": raced in the race of lobby 000000a1") && l.ends_with("(ban c1)")),
        "{lines:?}"
    );
    assert!(
        lines.iter().any(|l| l.starts_with("[ban] race ban #1 \"Evl\" (c1) for 14 d (until ")
            && l.contains(": \"Cheating in multiplayer races\"; by the server: its SKYLINE (type 27): 2829 kW, 1338 kg, 381 km/h, rated 1451, in a lobby sprint, 1st of 4 (lobby 000000a1, race 1757408b); out of races now: ")),
        "{lines:?}"
    );
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains("secret-token")), "the webhook's address is no line: {lines:?}");
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains("\"Ann\"") && l.starts_with("[ban]")), "{lines:?}");
}

// The control socket's file (app/control.rs): a stale one, as a server that died without its stop leaves it, is
// replaced at the start; a SIGTERM takes it away.  Of two servers on one state folder (the next one started before
// the one before stops), the later one's socket stays when the earlier one stops.
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
async fn the_control_socket_goes_with_its_server() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::FileTypeExt;
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let state = tmp.path().join("state");
    let sock = state.join("control.sock");
    let socket_there = || std::fs::symlink_metadata(&sock).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_socket());
    // a socket nobody listens on any more
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
    drop(std::os::unix::net::UnixListener::bind(&sock).unwrap());
    assert!(socket_there());
    let port = free_port();
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &[]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["bans"]), (0, "no bans".into()), "the stale socket replaced: {:?}", srv.lines());
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
    assert!(std::fs::symlink_metadata(&sock).is_err(), "SIGTERM: no control.sock left behind");
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["bans"]).0, 1, "nobody there");

    let (pa, pb) = (free_port(), free_port());
    let mut a = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, pa, &state, &[]), pa);
    a.ready().await;
    let mut b = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, pb, &state, &[]), pb);
    b.ready().await;
    assert_eq!(a.stop().await, Some(0));
    assert!(socket_there(), "the later server's socket stays");
    assert_eq!(ctl(&state, &["bans"]), (0, "no bans".into()), "and answers");
    assert_eq!(b.stop().await, Some(0));
    assert!(std::fs::symlink_metadata(&sock).is_err(), "gone with the later server");
}

/// one HTTP request (Host: localhost), its status and body
async fn http(port: u16, method: &str, path: &str, headers: &[(&str, &str)], body: &str) -> (u16, String) {
    let mut s = tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port)).await.unwrap();
    let mut q = format!("{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost:{port}\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n", body.len());
    for (k, v) in headers {
        q.push_str(&format!("{k}: {v}\r\n"));
    }
    q.push_str("\r\n");
    q.push_str(body);
    s.write_all(q.as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
    let mut r = Vec::new();
    s.read_to_end(&mut r).await.unwrap();
    let r = String::from_utf8_lossy(&r).to_string();
    let code = r.get(9..12).and_then(|c| c.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    (code, r.split_once("\r\n\r\n").map(|(_, b)| b.to_string()).unwrap_or_default())
}

/// a page's friend messages from the server, past the first `from` of them (free roam's friends: src/app/friends.rs)
fn friend_msgs(g: &Got, from: usize) -> Vec<Value> {
    g.ctl.iter().filter(|m| m["t"] == "friend").skip(from).cloned().collect()
}

// Free roam's friends through the whole server (src/app/friends.rs): pages whose players the hub linked ask about each
// other and befriend each other with their messages on /lan, each hears of the other's request and of the friendship;
// /friends shows the lists to the start page (where each friend plays) and takes its answers, a removal, a block;
// what is no claimed name, not linked, or not this server's own page takes no part; friends message each other (to
// the open page at once, else it waits and the start page takes it with the lists; a stranger's, an empty one, past
// the limit: not); and the friends are kept over a restart (the friends lists' shelf, nfsu2-online buddy.rs)
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn free_roams_friends_through_the_server() {
    use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let state = tmp.path().join("state");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
    let tok = |c: char| c.to_string().repeat(43);
    let now = nfsu2_util::now_ms();
    let claims = Claims::open(&state, now);
    for (n, c) in [("Al", 'A'), ("Bo", 'B'), ("Cy", 'C')] {
        claims.claim(n, &owner_of_token(&tok(c)).unwrap(), now).unwrap();
    }
    claims.save(now).unwrap();
    let port = free_port();
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--vault-gb", "1"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let bearer = |c: char| format!("Bearer {}", tok(c));
    let lists = |c: char| {
        let b = bearer(c);
        async move {
            let (code, body) = http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[("authorization", &b), ("sec-fetch-site", "same-origin")], "").await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{body}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&body).unwrap()
        }
    };
    // the start page: its own lists; no keyphrase, another site, a keyphrase without a name
    assert_eq!(
        lists('A').await,
        serde_json::json!({ "me": "Al_", "done": "ok", "friends": [], "asks": [], "sent": [], "mail": [], "contact": null })
    );
    assert_eq!(http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[], "").await.0, 401);
    assert_eq!(http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[("authorization", &bearer('A')), ("sec-fetch-site", "cross-site")], "").await.0, 403);
    assert_eq!(http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[("authorization", &bearer('A')), ("origin", "https://evil.example")], "").await.0, 403);
    assert_eq!(lists('D').await["me"], Value::Null);
    // in free roam: Al and Bo 4 m apart, Cy 2 km off, Dee (no keyphrase) beside Al
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let page = |name: &'static str, key: Option<char>, id: u32, x: f32| {
        let host = host.clone();
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_at(&host, port, "", None).await;
            let mut h = serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": name });
            if let Some(k) = key {
                h["claim"] = tok(k).into();
            }
            b.text(&h.to_string());
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(id, name.as_bytes())));
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_snap(id, [x, 0.0, 0.0])));
            b
        }
    };
    let al = page("Al", Some('A'), 701, 0.0).await;
    let bo = page("Bo", Some('B'), 702, 4.0).await;
    let cy = page("Cy", Some('C'), 703, 2000.0).await;
    let dee = page("Dee", None, 704, -4.0).await;
    for x in [&al, &bo, &cy, &dee] {
        x.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"list"}"#);
    }
    let n = |b: &Browser| friend_msgs(&b.got(), 0).len();
    async fn first(b: &Browser, op: &'static str, from: usize) -> Value {
        b.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, from).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == op)).await
    }
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "list", 0).await["me"], "Al_");
    assert_eq!(first(&dee, "list", 0).await["me"], Value::Null);
    // (the hub's ticks: linked)
    sleep(1500).await;
    let ask = |b: &Browser, op: &str, name: &str| b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "friend", "op": op, "name": name }).to_string());
    let (na, nb) = (n(&al), n(&bo));
    ask(&al, "can", "Bo");
    let c = first(&al, "can", na).await;
    assert_eq!((c["name"].as_str(), c["st"].as_str()), (Some("Bo_"), Some("new")), "{c}");
    for (who, st) in [("Cy", "far"), ("Dee", "theirs"), ("Nobody", "far")] {
        let k = n(&al);
        ask(&al, "can", who);
        assert_eq!(first(&al, "can", k).await["st"], st, "{who}");
    }
    let k = n(&dee);
    ask(&dee, "can", "Al");
    assert_eq!(first(&dee, "can", k).await["st"], "claim", "Dee has no claimed name");
    let k = n(&al);
    ask(&al, "add", "Cy");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "add", k).await["done"], "far", "a request to a player it is not linked with");
    // Al asks: Bo hears of it; the start pages see the request each way
    let k = n(&al);
    ask(&al, "add", "Bo");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "add", k).await["done"], "asked");
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "asks", nb).await["name"], "Al_");
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["sent"], serde_json::json!(["Bo_"]));
    assert_eq!(lists('B').await["asks"], serde_json::json!(["Al_"]));
    // Bo asks back: friends, both told, their lists again (and the hub has them)
    let (ka, kb) = (n(&al), n(&bo));
    ask(&bo, "add", "Al");
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "add", kb).await["done"], "friends");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "friends", ka).await["name"], "Bo_");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "list", ka).await["friends"], serde_json::json!(["Bo_"]));
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "list", kb).await["friends"], serde_json::json!(["Al_"]));
    let k = n(&al);
    ask(&al, "can", "Bo");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "can", k).await["st"], "friends");
    // messages: to Bo's open page at once; to a stranger, an empty one, then past the limit (3 at once) not
    let say = |b: &Browser, name: &str, body: &str, id: u32| {
        b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "msg", "name": name, "body": body, "id": id }).to_string())
    };
    async fn done(b: &Browser, id: u32, from: usize) -> Value {
        b.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, from).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == "msg" && m["id"] == id)).await
    }
    let (ka, kb) = (n(&al), n(&bo));
    say(&al, "Bo_", "meet me at the airport", 1);
    assert_eq!(done(&al, 1, ka).await["done"], "sent");
    let m = first(&bo, "mail", kb).await;
    assert_eq!((m["from"].as_str(), m["body"].as_str()), (Some("Al_"), Some("meet me at the airport")), "{m}");
    // (one at a time: each is handled on its own task)
    say(&al, "Cy_", "hi", 2);
    assert_eq!(done(&al, 2, ka).await["done"], "none", "not friends");
    say(&al, "Bo_", "   ", 3);
    assert_eq!(done(&al, 3, ka).await["done"], "empty");
    say(&al, "Bo_", "one more", 4);
    assert_eq!(done(&al, 4, ka).await["done"], "rate", "3 at once, then one every 2 s");
    let k = n(&dee);
    say(&dee, "Al_", "hi", 5);
    assert_eq!(done(&dee, 5, k).await["done"], "claim", "Dee has no claimed name");
    // the start page: Bo plays in free roam, in the room of everyone (its hash 0: the city's, no race track's); then Bo
    // leaves
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Bo_", "where": "roam", "room": "", "at": 0 }]));
    // ...and the game's page on its link (its notices, the page menu's Friends)
    let k = n(&al);
    al.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"where"}"#);
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "where", k).await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Bo_", "where": "roam", "room": "", "at": 0 }]));
    // Bo's page names its room, the room of everyone ("", which a display name's tidying makes "player"), and Bo drives
    // on the main world's Stadium drift: still the room of everyone, at that spot's room (Al's game says its HELLO
    // again too, as a game does every few seconds: one silent for gone_ms is off the hub)
    bo.text(r#"{"t":"room","name":""}"#);
    let drift = nfsu2_roam::track_room(0, 4311);
    bo.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named_in(702, b"Bo", drift)));
    al.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(701, b"Al")));
    sleep(1500).await;
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Bo_", "where": "roam", "room": "", "at": drift }]));
    bo.close().await;
    sleep(1200).await;
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Bo_", "where": "" }]));
    // Bo away: Al's message waits; Bo's start page takes it with the lists (once), and answers to Al's open page
    sleep(1000).await;
    let ka = n(&al);
    say(&al, "Bo_", "race later?", 6);
    assert_eq!(done(&al, 6, ka).await["done"], "kept");
    let mail = lists('B').await["mail"].clone();
    assert_eq!(
        (mail[0]["from"].as_str(), mail[0]["body"].as_str(), mail.as_array().map(Vec::len)),
        (Some("Al_"), Some("race later?"), Some(1)),
        "{mail}"
    );
    assert_eq!(lists('B').await["mail"], serde_json::json!([]));
    // the start page's answers: a removal (friends no more, on both lists), a block, an op that is none
    let post = |c: char, op: &str, name: &str| {
        let (b, body) = (bearer(c), serde_json::json!({ "op": op, "name": name }).to_string());
        async move {
            let (code, r) = http(port, "POST", "/friends", &[("authorization", &b), ("content-type", "application/json")], &body).await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{r}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&r).unwrap()
        }
    };
    let ka = n(&al);
    let r = http(
        port,
        "POST",
        "/friends",
        &[("authorization", &bearer('B')), ("content-type", "application/json")],
        r#"{"op":"msg","name":"Al_","body":"sure"}"#,
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!((r.0, serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&r.1).unwrap()["done"].clone()), (200, Value::from("sent")), "{}", r.1);
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "mail", ka).await["body"], "sure");
    assert_eq!(post('B', "remove", "Al_").await["done"], "ok");
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([]));
    assert_eq!(post('A', "remove", "Bo_").await["done"], "none");
    // a request by name from the start page: the name as typed, the claim's spelling; Cy's open page hears of it
    let kc = n(&cy);
    let r = post('A', "ask", "cy").await;
    assert_eq!((r["done"].as_str(), r["sent"].clone()), (Some("asked"), serde_json::json!(["Cy_"])), "{r}");
    assert_eq!(first(&cy, "asks", kc).await["name"], "Al_");
    // ...and accepts it on /friends, from afar (its game's Friends popup or line): Al's open page hears of it, and both
    // open pages get their lists again (the hub links them at once)
    let (ka, kc) = (n(&al), n(&cy));
    assert_eq!(post('C', "accept", "Al_").await["done"], "friends");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "friends", ka).await["name"], "Cy_");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "list", ka).await["friends"], serde_json::json!(["Cy_"]));
    let l = first(&cy, "list", kc).await;
    assert_eq!((l["friends"].clone(), l["asks"].clone()), (serde_json::json!(["Al_"]), serde_json::json!([])), "{l}");
    assert_eq!(post('C', "accept", "Al_").await["done"], "none", "no request waits now");
    assert_eq!(post('A', "ask", "Nobody").await["done"], "claim", "a name nobody claimed");
    assert_eq!(post('A', "ask", "al").await["done"], "self");
    assert_eq!(
        http(port, "POST", "/friends", &[("authorization", &bearer('A'))], r#"{"op":"befriend","name":"Bo"}"#).await.0,
        400,
        "no such op"
    );
    assert_eq!(post('A', "block", "Cy").await["done"], "name", "a name as the lists have it: its Online form");
    assert_eq!(post('A', "block", "Cy_").await["done"], "ok");
    // befriended again in free roam, then a restart: kept
    let bo = page("Bo", Some('B'), 705, 4.0).await;
    bo.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"list"}"#);
    sleep(1500).await;
    let kb = n(&bo);
    ask(&al, "add", "Bo");
    ask(&bo, "add", "Al");
    let _ = bo
        .until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, kb).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == "list" && m["friends"] == serde_json::json!(["Al_"])))
        .await;
    // a Discord username from the start page: Discord's form only; Bo sees it on the start page and in the game
    assert_eq!(post('A', "discord", "Al Races").await["done"], "name");
    let r = post('A', "discord", "@Al.Races").await;
    assert_eq!((r["done"].as_str(), r["contact"].as_str()), (Some("ok"), Some("al.races")), "{r}");
    assert_eq!(
        lists('B').await["friends"],
        serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Al_", "where": "roam", "room": "", "at": 0, "contact": "al.races" }])
    );
    let kb = n(&bo);
    ask(&bo, "where", "");
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "where", kb).await["friends"][0]["contact"], "al.races");
    // five changes, then one every 10 s
    let mut dones = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..4 {
        dones.push(post('A', "discord", "al.races").await["done"].as_str().unwrap().to_string());
    }
    assert_eq!(dones, ["ok", "ok", "ok", "rate"]);
    // a crew's invite (the start page's, the game's Friends): Bo's open page hears it, the names tidied; not to Cy (no
    // friend), nor a crew no page would take; Bo gone from free roam: away
    let invite = |to: &str, crew: &str, room: &str| {
        let (b, body) = (bearer('A'), serde_json::json!({ "op": "crew", "name": to, "crew": crew, "room": room }).to_string());
        async move {
            let (code, r) = http(port, "POST", "/friends", &[("authorization", &b), ("content-type", "application/json")], &body).await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{r}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&r).unwrap()["done"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
        }
    };
    let kb = n(&bo);
    assert_eq!(invite("bo_", "  Night \u{200b}Owls ", "Blue  Room").await, "sent");
    let m = first(&bo, "crew", kb).await;
    assert_eq!((m["name"].as_str(), m["crew"].as_str(), m["room"].as_str()), (Some("Al_"), Some("Night Owls"), Some("Blue Room")), "{m}");
    assert_eq!(invite("Cy_", "Night Owls", "").await, "none", "not a friend");
    assert_eq!(invite("Bo_", "x_fag_x", "").await, "name", "reads as a slur");
    let kb = n(&bo);
    assert_eq!(invite("Bo_", "Night Owls", "").await, "sent");
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "crew", kb).await["room"], "", "the room of everyone stays none");
    assert_eq!(invite("Bo_", &"x".repeat(25), "").await, "name", "past 24 characters");
    for x in [al, bo, cy, dee] {
        x.close().await;
    }
    sleep(1200).await;
    assert_eq!(invite("Bo_", "Night Owls", "").await, "away", "not in free roam");
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
    let lines = srv.lines();
    for l in [
        "\"Al_\" asked \"Bo_\" to be friends (free roam)",
        "\"Bo_\" and \"Al_\" are friends (asked back in free roam)",
        "\"Al_\" sent \"Bo_\" a message (got it)",
        "\"Al_\" sent \"Bo_\" a message (away, it waits)",
        "\"Al_\" asked \"Cy_\" to be friends (the start page)",
        "\"Al_\" set a Discord name",
    ] {
        assert!(lines.iter().any(|x| x.contains(l)), "{l}: {lines:?}");
    }
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|x| x.contains("al.races")), "the log never has it");
    assert!(!lines.iter().any(|x| x.contains("Night Owls") || x.contains("Blue Room")), "nor a crew's invite");
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--vault-gb", "1"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    assert_eq!(lists('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Bo_", "where": "" }]), "over the restart");
    assert_eq!(lists('B').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Al_", "where": "", "contact": "al.races" }]), "over the restart");
    // the limits: a page's friend messages (10, then one every 2 s), a client's reads of /friends (60, then one a second)
    let al = page("Al", Some('A'), 706, 0.0).await;
    sleep(300).await;
    for _ in 0..30 {
        ask(&al, "can", "Bo");
    }
    sleep(1500).await;
    let answered = friend_msgs(&al.got(), 0).iter().filter(|m| m["op"] == "can").count();
    assert!((9..=11).contains(&answered), "{answered} of 30 asked at once answered");
    let mut codes = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..70 {
        codes.push(http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[("authorization", &bearer('A'))], "").await.0);
    }
    assert!(codes.iter().filter(|&&c| c == 429).count() >= 5 && codes[0] == 200, "{codes:?}");
    al.close().await;
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
}

// The 2026-11-05 security audit's rename bait: a player whose edited game shows a victim's claimed name over its car,
// its page under an offensive name for the operator to rename.  The rename takes the offensive name only, and says
// why not the other: the victim's claim stays its own, its page plays on, and nobody is refused its name or the ones
// that read the same.  Nor is a name over the car that reads as another player's claimed name taken (that player
// would be asked for another name too); naming it takes it.
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn a_rename_takes_no_other_keyphrases_name() {
    use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let state = tmp.path().join("state");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
    let tok = |c: char| c.to_string().repeat(43);
    let now = nfsu2_util::now_ms();
    let claims = Claims::open(&state, now);
    claims.claim("Victor", &owner_of_token(&tok('V')).unwrap(), now).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Wendy", &owner_of_token(&tok('W')).unwrap(), now).unwrap();
    claims.save(now).unwrap();
    let port = free_port();
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--vault-gb", "1", "--online", "off"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let names = |c: char, n: &'static str| {
        let b = format!("Bearer {}", tok(c));
        async move {
            let (code, body) =
                http(port, "GET", &format!("/names?name={n}"), &[("authorization", &b), ("sec-fetch-site", "same-origin")], "").await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{body}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&body).unwrap()
        }
    };
    assert_eq!(names('V', "Victor").await["state"], "yours");
    // the victims play under their claims; the attackers under offensive page names, the victims' names over their cars
    let open = |xff: &'static str, page: &'static str, claim: Option<char>, id: u32, game: &'static [u8]| {
        let host = host.clone();
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_from(&host, port, "", None, None, Some(xff)).await;
            let mut h = serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": page, "id": format!("page-{id}") });
            if let Some(c) = claim {
                h["claim"] = tok(c).into();
            }
            b.text(&h.to_string());
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(id, game)));
            b
        }
    };
    let victor = open("192.0.2.9", "Victor", Some('V'), 601, b"Victor").await;
    let wendy = open("192.0.2.8", "Wendy", Some('W'), 602, b"Wendy").await;
    let meanie = open("192.0.2.1", "Meanie", None, 501, b"Victor").await;
    let rude = open("192.0.2.2", "Rude", None, 502, b"W3ndy").await;
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    while !(ctl(&state, &["who", "meanie"]).1.contains("its game shows \"Victor\"")
        && ctl(&state, &["who", "rude"]).1.contains("its game shows \"W3ndy\""))
        && t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3)
    {
        sleep(50).await;
    }
    let rn = ctl(&state, &["rename", "Meanie", "Offensive", "name"]);
    assert_eq!(rn.0, 0, "{}", rn.1);
    assert!(rn.1.starts_with("rename #1: \"Meanie\" taken away from everyone, and the names that read the same\n"), "{}", rn.1);
    assert!(rn.1.contains("\nnot taken: \"Victor\" (another keyphrase's claimed name); to take one, name it\n"), "{}", rn.1);
    assert!(!rn.1.contains("its claim went"), "{}", rn.1);
    assert_eq!(meanie.until_ms(3000, |g| g.closed.clone()).await, (4004, "rename".into()));
    let after = names('V', "Victor").await;
    assert_eq!((after["state"].as_str(), after["mine"].is_object()), (Some("yours"), true), "the victim's claim stays: {after}");
    assert_ne!(names('V', "V1ct0r1999").await["state"], "blocked", "nor are the names that read the same refused");
    // a lookalike over the car of another player's claimed name, the same
    let rn = ctl(&state, &["rename", "Rude"]);
    assert!(
        rn.1.contains(&format!("not taken: \"W3ndy\" (reads as {} \"Wendy\", that player's claimed name)", nfsu2_util::vip_str(wendy.vip))),
        "{}",
        rn.1
    );
    assert_eq!(rude.until_ms(3000, |g| g.closed.clone()).await, (4004, "rename".into()));
    sleep(300).await;
    assert!(victor.is_open() && wendy.is_open(), "the victims play on");
    let taken = ctl(&state, &["names"]).1;
    assert!(taken.contains("\"Meanie\"") && taken.contains("\"Rude\"") && !taken.contains("Victor") && !taken.contains("ndy"), "{taken}");
    let lines = srv.lines();
    assert!(
        lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains(
            "[ban] rename #1 \"Meanie\": \"Meanie\": \"Offensive name\"; not taken: \"Victor\" (another keyphrase's claimed name)"
        )),
        "{lines:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
}

// The 2026-11-05 security audit's one-sided friend: a name on one friends list alone (one the Messenger's RADD LIST=B
// put there unasked, before it became a request; or a friend's name another keyphrase claimed since) tells its list's
// player nothing: neither on its link nor on the start page does it hear where the other plays, nor its room; asked
// and accepted, a friendship both ways does
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn a_one_sided_friend_learns_nothing() {
    use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let state = tmp.path().join("state");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
    let tok = |c: char| c.to_string().repeat(43);
    let now = nfsu2_util::now_ms();
    let claims = Claims::open(&state, now);
    let mallory = owner_of_token(&tok('A')).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Mallory", &mallory, now).unwrap();
    claims.claim("Victim", &owner_of_token(&tok('V')).unwrap(), now).unwrap();
    claims.save(now).unwrap();
    // Mallory's list on the shelf (nfsu2-online buddy.rs: <state>/online/friends/<2 hex>/<32 hex>.json) names Victim;
    // Victim's names nobody
    let h: String = Sha256::digest(b"mallory").iter().take(16).map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
    let shelf = state.join("online").join("friends").join(&h[..2]);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&shelf).unwrap();
    let list = serde_json::json!({ "v": 4, "name": "Mallory", "seen": "2026-11", "owner": &*mallory, "B": ["Victim"] });
    std::fs::write(shelf.join(format!("{h}.json")), list.to_string()).unwrap();
    let port = free_port();
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--vault-gb", "1"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let bearer = |c: char| format!("Bearer {}", tok(c));
    let page = |name: &'static str, key: char, id: u32, x: f32| {
        let host = host.clone();
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_at(&host, port, "", None).await;
            b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": name, "claim": tok(key) }).to_string());
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(id, name.as_bytes())));
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_snap(id, [x, 0.0, 0.0])));
            b
        }
    };
    // Victim in free roam 3 km off; Mallory's page asks for its friends, then where they play
    let victim = page("Victim", 'V', 801, 3000.0).await;
    let mal = page("Mallory", 'A', 802, 0.0).await;
    for p in [&victim, &mal] {
        p.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"list"}"#);
    }
    async fn first(b: &Browser, op: &'static str, from: usize) -> Value {
        b.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, from).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == op)).await
    }
    assert_eq!(first(&mal, "list", 0).await["friends"], serde_json::json!(["Victim"]), "the name on its list");
    sleep(1500).await;
    let n = |b: &Browser| friend_msgs(&b.got(), 0).len();
    let k = n(&mal);
    mal.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"where"}"#);
    let nowhere = serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Victim", "where": "" }]);
    assert_eq!(first(&mal, "where", k).await["friends"], nowhere, "on its link");
    let get = |c: char| {
        let b = bearer(c);
        async move {
            let (code, body) = http(port, "GET", "/friends", &[("authorization", &b), ("sec-fetch-site", "same-origin")], "").await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{body}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&body).unwrap()
        }
    };
    assert_eq!(get('A').await["friends"], nowhere, "on the start page");
    // asked (not "friends": the name on its list is no friendship), accepted: friends both ways, and where it plays
    let post = |c: char, op: &'static str, name: &'static str| {
        let b = bearer(c);
        async move {
            let body = serde_json::json!({ "op": op, "name": name }).to_string();
            let (code, r) = http(port, "POST", "/friends", &[("authorization", &b), ("content-type", "application/json")], &body).await;
            assert_eq!(code, 200, "{r}");
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&r).unwrap()["done"].clone()
        }
    };
    assert_eq!(post('A', "ask", "Victim").await, "asked");
    assert_eq!(post('V', "accept", "Mallory").await, "friends");
    assert_eq!(get('A').await["friends"], serde_json::json!([{ "name": "Victim", "where": "roam", "room": "", "at": 0 }]));
    for p in [victim, mal] {
        p.close().await;
    }
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
}

/// a race lobby's message to the hub (to 0) as roam_core.c lays it out (op arg state max, to, lobby, race, x y, t, n,
/// away seconds, ids): the host's advert (op 1)
fn roam_lobby(sender: u32, op: u8, lobby: u32, race: u32, state: u8, max: u8, ids: &[u32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut p = vec![0u8; 24 + 4 * ids.len()];
    p[0] = op;
    p[2] = state;
    p[3] = max;
    p[8..12].copy_from_slice(&lobby.to_le_bytes());
    p[12..16].copy_from_slice(&race.to_le_bytes());
    p[22] = ids.len() as u8;
    for (i, v) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
        p[24 + 4 * i..28 + 4 * i].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    dgram(12, sender, &p)
}

// An invite to a race lobby (src/app/friends.rs "invite"): a friend both ways, in free roam in the host's room, hears
// it on its open page with the lobby as the hub has it (its host's id and its own, the race, its players), the race's
// kind as one of the game's words and its stage 0 to 9; the host's page hears what became of it: "nolobby" while it
// hosts none, "none" to a player not its friend, "full", "away" once the friend left free roam, "claim" without a
// claimed name, and past six at once "rate"
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
async fn a_friend_is_invited_to_a_race_lobby_through_the_server() {
    use nfsu2_claims::{Claims, owner_of_token};
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (data, wasm) = game_folder(tmp.path());
    let state = tmp.path().join("state");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&state).unwrap();
    let tok = |c: char| c.to_string().repeat(43);
    let now = nfsu2_util::now_ms();
    let claims = Claims::open(&state, now);
    for (n, c) in [("Al", 'A'), ("Bo", 'B'), ("Cy", 'C')] {
        claims.claim(n, &owner_of_token(&tok(c)).unwrap(), now).unwrap();
    }
    claims.save(now).unwrap();
    let port = free_port();
    let mut srv = Server::spawn(command(&data, &wasm, port, &state, &["--vault-gb", "1"]), port);
    srv.ready().await;
    let host = format!("localhost:{port}");
    let page = |name: &'static str, key: Option<char>, id: u32, x: f32| {
        let host = host.clone();
        async move {
            let b = Browser::open_at(&host, port, "", None).await;
            let mut h = serde_json::json!({ "t": "hello", "name": name });
            if let Some(k) = key {
                h["claim"] = tok(k).into();
            }
            b.text(&h.to_string());
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_hello_named(id, name.as_bytes())));
            b.binary(to_hub(&roam_snap(id, [x, 0.0, 0.0])));
            b
        }
    };
    let al = page("Al", Some('A'), 701, 0.0).await;
    let bo = page("Bo", Some('B'), 702, 4.0).await;
    let cy = page("Cy", Some('C'), 703, 2000.0).await;
    let dee = page("Dee", None, 704, -4.0).await;
    for x in [&al, &bo, &cy, &dee] {
        x.text(r#"{"t":"friend","op":"list"}"#);
    }
    let n = |b: &Browser| friend_msgs(&b.got(), 0).len();
    async fn first(b: &Browser, op: &'static str, from: usize) -> Value {
        b.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, from).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == op)).await
    }
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "list", 0).await["me"], "Al_");
    // (the hub's ticks: linked) Al and Bo befriend each other
    sleep(1500).await;
    let ask = |b: &Browser, op: &str, name: &str| b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "friend", "op": op, "name": name }).to_string());
    let k = n(&al);
    ask(&al, "add", "Bo");
    assert_eq!(first(&al, "add", k).await["done"], "asked");
    let k = n(&bo);
    ask(&bo, "add", "Al");
    assert_eq!(first(&bo, "add", k).await["done"], "friends");
    let invite = |b: &Browser, name: &str, kind: &str, stage: Value| {
        b.text(&serde_json::json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "invite", "name": name, "kind": kind, "stage": stage }).to_string())
    };
    // what became of each one: (the friend's name as listed, done), one at a time (each on its own task)
    async fn done(b: &Browser, from: usize) -> (String, String) {
        let m = b.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, from).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == "invite" && m.get("done").is_some())).await;
        (m["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(), m["done"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string())
    }
    let k = n(&al);
    invite(&al, "bo_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, k).await, ("Bo_".into(), "nolobby".into()), "no lobby yet");
    // Al opens a lobby (its advert to the hub)
    al.binary(to_hub(&roam_lobby(701, 1, 0xA1, 0x1111, 0, 6, &[701])));
    sleep(300).await;
    let k = n(&al);
    invite(&al, "Cy_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, k).await, ("Cy_".into(), "none".into()), "not a friend");
    let (ka, kb) = (n(&al), n(&bo));
    invite(&al, "Bo_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, ka).await, ("Bo_".into(), "sent".into()));
    let m = bo.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, kb).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == "invite")).await;
    assert_eq!(
        m,
        serde_json::json!({ "t": "friend", "op": "invite", "name": "Al_", "host": 701, "lobby": 0xA1, "race": 0x1111, "n": 1, "max": 6,
                            "kind": "drift", "stage": 3 })
    );
    let (ka, kb) = (n(&al), n(&bo));
    invite(&al, "Bo_", "<b>", 99.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, ka).await.1, "sent");
    let m = bo.until_ms(4000, move |g| friend_msgs(g, kb).into_iter().find(|m| m["op"] == "invite")).await;
    assert_eq!((m["kind"].as_str(), m["stage"].as_i64()), (Some("race"), Some(9)), "a kind not the game's, a stage past 9: {m}");
    // full
    al.binary(to_hub(&roam_lobby(701, 1, 0xA1, 0x1111, 0, 2, &[701, 703])));
    sleep(300).await;
    let k = n(&al);
    invite(&al, "Bo_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, k).await.1, "full");
    // Bo leaves free roam: away
    al.binary(to_hub(&roam_lobby(701, 1, 0xA1, 0x1111, 0, 6, &[701])));
    bo.close().await;
    sleep(1200).await;
    let k = n(&al);
    invite(&al, "Bo_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, k).await.1, "away");
    // six at once, then one every 5 s
    let k = n(&al);
    invite(&al, "Bo_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&al, k).await.1, "rate");
    // no claimed name
    let k = n(&dee);
    invite(&dee, "Al_", "drift", 3.into());
    assert_eq!(done(&dee, k).await, ("Al_".into(), "claim".into()));
    for x in [al, cy, dee] {
        x.close().await;
    }
    assert_eq!(srv.stop().await, Some(0));
}

//! What the integration tests share: a switch (nfsu2-lan) on an ephemeral port of 127.0.0.1 with the Online host
//! (nfsu2-online) and the free-roam hub (nfsu2-roam) attached as src/app/run.rs wires them, fake browsers on its
//! WebSocket (tokio-tungstenite), and what they send: the switch's frames, the virtual host's (nfsu2-online
//! `vhost::lan_frame`), roam_core.c's datagrams, the lobby's messages (as nfsu2-online's `aries` writes and reads
//! them: `encode_frame`, `FrameReader`, `FieldMap`).
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::collections::HashMap;
